AddEdge.description:
Add an edge with a new id (in `CommitResult.edge_ids`). Both endpoints
must exist.

AnalyzeRequest.description: An analytics job on a projection of a namespace.

AnalyzeResponse.description:
One chunk of a job's result: rows of the kind `kind` names (the same in
every chunk).

AnswerMeta.description: What every answer reports besides its value.

next.description:
The cursor of the next page, for paginated reads with more results.
Empty: no more pages.

seq.description: The seq of the namespace state the read saw.

truncated.description: A limit stopped the read and `partial` asked for what was found.

AppendAttr.description:
Append `value` to the list in attribute `key`; a missing or none
attribute becomes a one-item list, any other value is `invalid_argument`.

AttrPath.description:
An attribute path: a top-level attribute name, then keys into nested
dicts.

CatalogChange.description:
A change to a namespace's catalog, committed on its own.

At most one of `createIndex`, `dropIndex`, `addConstraint`, `dropConstraint` (`kind`).

addConstraint.description: Add a constraint; fails if the existing data violates it.

createIndex.description: Declare an index and build it (online).

ChangeEvent.description:
One commit.

At most one of `data`, `catalog` (`change`).

idempotencyKey.description: The idempotency key the commit was made with, if any.

timeMicros.description:
When the WAL appended the commit, in microseconds since 1970 (UTC).
Missing for commits logged in WAL format 1.

ChangeOp.description:
One resolved op of a data commit: the core's `Op`. Applying a commit's
ops in order to the state before it gives the state after it.

At most one of `addNode`, `removeNode`, `renameNode`, `addLabel`, `removeLabel`, `setNode`, `setNodeAttr`, `setNodeVersion`, `addEdge`, `removeEdge`, `setEdgeType`, `setEdge`, `setEdgeAttr`, `setEdgeVersion` (`kind`).

addEdge.description: Add an edge with its id (ids are never reused).

addNode.description: Add a node with labels and a payload (its id is new).

removeNode.description: Remove a node and all of its edges (there is no op per edge).

setEdgeAttr.description: Set or (without `value`) remove one attribute of an edge.

setNodeAttr.description: Set or (without `value`) remove one attribute of a node.

idempotencyKey.description:
Commit at most once under this key (1 to 255 bytes, for example a
UUID): a retry with the same key and request returns the original
result with `deduplicated` set. Send one with every commit that may be
retried, in particular after a deadline or a lost connection.

CommitResult.description: The outcome of a successful commit.

deduplicated.description:
This is the original result of an earlier commit with the same
idempotency key; nothing was committed now.

edgeIds.description: One id per `add_edge` and `upsert_edge`, in mutation order.

seq.description: The commit's position in the namespace's history.

timeMicros.description: When the WAL appended the commit, in microseconds since 1970 (UTC).

versions.description: Nodes by id, then edges by id. Empty for catalog changes.

Constraint.description: A constraint on the nodes with `label`, at attribute `path`.

ConstraintKind.description:
What a constraint requires of the nodes with its label.

- `CONSTRAINT_KIND_UNIQUE`: No two nodes with the label have equal values at the path.

- `CONSTRAINT_KIND_REQUIRED`: Every node with the label has a (non-none) value at the path.

Coords.description:
Where a node's coordinates live. Without a kind: the core's default.

At most one of `sequence`, `perDimension` (`kind`).

sequence.description: One attribute path to a list of numbers.

CreateNamespaceRequest.description: Create a namespace. With a key, a retry returns the original event.

deduplicated.description: This is the original event of an earlier request with the same key.

CutTail.description: A torn tail cut off the last WAL segment.

discardedFrames.description:
Complete frames discarded with the tail (never acknowledged as
durable).

fileLen.description: The segment's length before, and after (0: the file was removed).

removed.description: The segment had no valid header and was removed.

Damage.description:
What was wrong with a torn WAL tail.

- `DAMAGE_TRUNCATED`: The file ends inside a header or record.

- `DAMAGE_BAD_HEADER`: Invalid segment header.

- `DAMAGE_BAD_LENGTH`: A record length above the limit.

- `DAMAGE_CHECKSUM`: A checksum mismatch.

DataChange.description: The ops of a data commit.

incoming.description: Count incoming instead of outgoing edges.

DeleteNode.description: Delete the node and its edges.

Direction.description:
Which edges a search follows.

- `DIRECTION_UNSPECIFIED`: Outgoing edges (the default).

Double.description: A floating-point number; NaN and the infinities as strings.

DropNamespaceRequest.description: Drop a namespace and its data. `default` can't be dropped.

Edge.description: An edge, as read from the store.

EdgeCost.description:
What traversing an edge costs. Without a kind: every edge costs 1.

At most one of `unit`, `weighted` (`kind`).

EdgeEndpoints.description: Two nodes and an edge type (missing: an untyped edge).

EdgeKey.description:
How an edge upsert finds its edge.

At most one of `id`, `endpoints` (`kind`).

endpoints.description:
The edge between these nodes with exactly this type; added if there
is none, `invalid_argument` if there are several.

id.description: The edge with this id, which must exist.

Error.description:
An error as a message, for access methods that carry errors in a body
(REST, step 12): the same code and message as the gRPC status.

building.description: Attribute paths of the filter whose index is being built.

estimatedCandidates.description: The estimated number of candidates `Find` checks.

analyze.description: Also run the index lookup and report the exact number of candidates.

Expr.description: A filter over a node or an edge: the core's `Expr` in its serde JSON form, for example `{"Label": "Person"}` or `{"Compare": {"path": ["age"], "op": "Ge", "value": {"Int": 18}}}`. `And`, `Or` and `Not` nest at most 100 levels.

path.description: An attribute name, then keys into nested dicts.
An attribute name, then keys into nested dicts.
An attribute name, then keys into nested dicts.

FindRequest.description: Nodes matching a filter, by index or scan; paginated by id.

meta.description: `seq` is the streamable seq when the batch was read.

GetEdgesRequest.description: The edges `ids`, in the order asked; at most `max_results` ids.

GetNodesRequest.description: The nodes `ids`, in the order asked; at most `max_results` ids.

IndexDef.description: A node property index on an attribute path.

entries.description: Nodes with an indexable (scalar) value at the path.

IndexStatus.description:
One index of a namespace.

At most one of `ready`, `building` (`state`).

building.description: An online build is reading the nodes; reads don't use it yet.

ready.description: Built and kept up to date by every commit.

size.description: Missing while the index is being built.

Int64.description: A 64-bit integer as a decimal string (a JSON number is accepted too).

Job.description:
An analytics job, run by the core's algorithms.

At most one of `pageRank`, `degree`, `weaklyConnectedComponents`, `stronglyConnectedComponents`, `leiden`, `labelPropagation`, `coreNumber`, `triangles` (`kind`).

degree.description: Scores: the number of edges per node, normalised by n - 1.

triangles.description: Counts: the triangles through each node.

JobResultKind.description:
What kind of rows a job returns.

- `JOB_RESULT_KIND_SCORES`: `scores`: per node, by score (highest first), then id.

- `JOB_RESULT_KIND_GROUPS`: `groups`: node ids (each group sorted), biggest first, then by first id.

- `JOB_RESULT_KIND_COUNTS`: `counts`: per node, by count (highest first), then id.

LeidenJob.description: Leiden; missing options take the core's defaults.

Limits.description: Limits a read asks for (see the file comment).

maxEdges.description: Most edges the read may examine.

maxResults.description: Most results in the answer: the page size of a paginated read.

maxVisited.description: Most nodes the read may visit.

Lookup.description:
How a property index is read.

- `LOOKUP_POINT`: One value (`Eq`).

- `LOOKUP_IN`: Several values (`In`); see `PlanIndex.in_values`.

- `LOOKUP_RANGE`: A range.

MarkStatus.description:
A mark: the position in an external log up to which a projection's
events are committed, and the seq of the commit that set it.

MatchPatternRequest.description: Every match of a pattern; paginated by row.

filters.description: `where`: a filter per named node variable, added to the pattern's own.

MatchRow.description:
One match: a node id per pattern node and the edge ids per pattern
edge (one for a single edge, the path for a variable-length one), in the
pattern's order.

MaybeEdge.description: An edge that may not exist (in the order asked for).

edge.description: Missing if there is no edge with the id.

MaybeNode.description: A node that may not exist (in the order asked for).

node.description: Missing if there is no node with the id.

Metric.description:
The distance between two coordinate vectors.

- `METRIC_UNSPECIFIED`: Euclidean (the default).

Mutation.description:
One change in a transaction.

At most one of `upsertNode`, `deleteNode`, `addEdge`, `upsertEdge`, `deleteEdge`, `setAttr`, `removeAttr`, `appendAttr`, `addLabel`, `removeLabel`, `setEdgeType` (`kind`).

NamespaceCatalog.description: A namespace's indexes and constraints, sorted.

NamespaceEvent.description: An event of the namespace log.

id.description: The namespace's id: assigned at creation, never reused.

idempotencyKey.description: The idempotency key of the request, if it had one.

createdMicros.description: The time of its create event, in microseconds since 1970 (UTC).

createdSeq.description: The number of its create event.

NamespaceStatus.description: What an open namespace reports about itself.

checkpointFailure.description: The last checkpoint error, if the last checkpoint failed.

createdMicros.description:
When the namespace was created, in microseconds since 1970 (UTC); 0
for one that predates layout 4.

indexes.description:
Declared indexes, those unique constraints need, and builds in
progress, sorted by path.

marks.description:
The namespace's marks (ADR 0032), by name: how far each projection
has committed its source's events.

memoryBytes.description: Approximate bytes the graph uses, indexes included.

readOnly.description: Why the namespace is read-only, if it is.

recovery.description: What recovery did to this namespace when the server's store opened.

seq.description: The seq of the last applied commit.

syncedSeq.description:
The highest seq known to be durable; missing under the `off` fsync
policy until an explicit sync.

NeighbourhoodRequest.description: The nodes within `depth` edges of the seeds; paginated by id.

depth.description: How many edges away a node may be (0: the seeds only).

edgeFilter.description: Follow only edges matching this filter.

edgeTypes.description: Follow only edges with one of these types (all if empty).

nodeFilter.description: Return only nodes matching this filter (it doesn't prune the search).

seeds.description: Ids that don't exist are skipped.

Node.description: A node, as read from the store.

version.description: Starts at 1, one more for every commit that wrote the node.

Order.description:
The order of a traversal.

- `ORDER_UNSPECIFIED`: Breadth first (the default).

- `ORDER_BFS`: Breadth first: nodes by distance from the start.

- `ORDER_DFS`: Depth first, pre-order.

PageRankJob.description: PageRank; missing options take the core's defaults (those of networkx).

tol.description:
Converged when the L1 change of the ranks is below n * tol; 0 runs
exactly `max_iter` iterations.

cost.description: The sum of the edge costs (for BFS: the number of edges).

nodes.description: From the start to the end, both included.

PathMethod.description:
The algorithm of a shortest path. Without a kind: BFS.

At most one of `bfs`, `dijkstra`, `aStar` (`kind`).

aStar.description:
Cheapest path by `cost`, guided by the distance between node
coordinates (which must not overestimate the cost).

bfs.description: Fewest edges (bidirectional BFS); `cost` must be unit.

Pattern.description: A graph pattern: the core's Cypher-like text, for example `(a:Person {age: 30})-[:knows*1..3]->(b)`, or, for patterns the text can't express (filters other than property equality, bound ids), the core's `Pattern` in its serde JSON form (an object with `nodes` and `edges`).

Plan.description:
Where `Find` gets its candidates from. Unions nest as the filter's `Or`s
do.

At most one of `empty`, `label`, `index`, `union`, `scan`, `other` (`kind`).

empty.description: The filter is `Const(false)`: nothing to read.

other.description: A plan of a newer core, in its debug form.

union.description: The union of the plans of an `Or`.

Projection.description:
What a job runs on: every node, and the edges followed in `direction`,
weighted by `cost`.

cursor.description:
Continue a paginated read: the `next` of the previous page, with the
same request. Empty: the first page.

history.description:
The history `min_seq` belongs to (32 hex digits); a seq of another
history is `invalid_argument`. Empty: not checked.

minSeq.description: Read-your-writes: wait until the namespace has applied this seq.

partial.description:
When a limit is reached: false fails with `budget_exceeded`, true
answers with what was found and `truncated` set (and no cursor).

timeoutMs.description:
How long the read may take, in milliseconds, counted from when the
server starts the request (the `min_seq` wait included). The smaller of
this and the `grpc-timeout` header applies (ADR 0026).

allowRevisit.description: Whether a walk may visit a node twice.

seed.description:
The same seed gives the same walks for the same graph state in the same
server process; random if missing.

walks.description: How many walks to attempt; duplicates are removed.

RecordData.description: A node's or edge's payload in an op.

RecoveryReport.description: What recovery found and did to one namespace.

checkpoint.description:
The seq of the checkpoint recovery started from; missing if it started
from an empty namespace.

createdIndexes.description: Catalog indexes the loaded checkpoint didn't have, now built.

droppedIndexes.description: Indexes the checkpoint had but the catalog doesn't list, now dropped.

replayed.description: WAL records replayed on top of the checkpoint.

seq.description: The seq the namespace was recovered to.

skippedCheckpoints.description: Newer checkpoints that failed to load, newest first.

tornTail.description: The torn tail cut off the log, if any.

RemoveAttr.description: Remove one top-level attribute (nothing to remove is fine).

SetEdgeType.description: Set (present) or clear (missing) an edge's type.

ShortestPathRequest.description: A shortest path between two nodes.

maxCost.description: Ignore paths that cost more (for BFS: have more edges).

maxDepth.description: BFS only: at most this many edges.

path.description: Missing if there is no path.

SubgraphRequest.description: The nodes within `depth` edges of the seeds and the edges between them.

edgeFilter.description: Follow, and return, only edges matching this filter.

edgeTypes.description: Follow, and return, only edges with one of these types (all if empty).

edges.description: Sorted by id over the whole stream.

nodes.description: Sorted by id over the whole stream.

Target.description:
A node (by id) or an edge (by id).

At most one of `node`, `edge` (`kind`).

TraverseRequest.description: A breadth- or depth-first traversal, in traversal order.

depth.description: How many edges away from the start a node may be (missing: any).

Uint64.description: An unsigned 64-bit integer as a decimal string (a JSON number is accepted too).

UpsertEdge.description:
Replace an edge's attributes and meta, or add the edge (for
`EdgeKey.endpoints`). Its id is in `CommitResult.edge_ids`.

UpsertNode.description:
Create the node, or replace its attributes and meta. The labels are
added; labels the node has already are kept.

Value.description: An attribute or meta value: the core's `Value` in its serde JSON form, for example `{"Int": 30}`, `{"String": "ann"}` or `"None"`. Lists and dicts nest at most 100 levels.

DateTime.description: ISO 8601, with or without a UTC offset.

Version.description: The new version of an entity a commit wrote.

seq.description: The namespace's seq once it had applied the seq asked for.

WeightedCost.description:
The edge attribute `key`, or `default_weight` for edges without it.
Weights must be non-negative numbers.

Work.description: How much work a read did.

get.description:
Follow the change stream: the server answers `GetChanges` with `wait`
in a loop and sends each batch as a message, from `from_seq` on, until
the client cancels, an error ends the stream, or the server shuts down
(`unavailable`). Each round waits for about `options.timeout_ms`
(default and cap: the server's); a round that finds nothing sends a
message without events (a heartbeat with `next_seq`).
